ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_001.en: Zul’jin! Fallen pretender to a long-shattered throne! You sought to bring war upon my people but has brought naught but ruin to your misbegotten kind! Come forth, humbled beast, and answer for your crimes against the kingdom of Quel’thalas!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_001.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_002.en: Aaah. Da ‘high king’ of da elves himself be ‘gracing us’ with a visit to Zul’Aman. It be about time you climbed down from your high chair…King Sunstrider.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_002.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_003.en: You dared to mingle with vile foreign monsters, unleashing their savagery upon our forests and Silvermoon itself. But now, as it always is with beasts, they have scattered to the winds and left you to face our wrath alone… and for what you have done, there can be but one answer…
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_003.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_004.en: Our companions from the Alliance will deal with these brutes that yet remain at your side, mongrel, whilst the fury of the elves will be aimed at you alone. We seek not only your head, or the destruction of this pathetic claypit… we seek the end of your entire race, once and for all!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_004.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_005.en: I spit on your legacy and weakling fury, filthy elf! You stole our lands and den you dare call dem yours?! You think you got what it takes to exterminate us! Come den, false king, Zul’Aman will be your tomb!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_005.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_006.en: Very well then, avengers of Quel’thalas! Commence the siege!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_006.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_001.en: Warlord Zul’jin…that is a mighty host. I’m afraid my humble forces will not be enough to deter them.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_001.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_002.en: Don’t you worry none, captain Tharbek. You be on our lands now. We will show you how we deal with dem weakling elves and their allies. Fall back to the city. I’ll call on your aid whenever I need it.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_002.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S003_001.en: Amani’shi! Da elves and their human ally scum have invaded our sacred homeland! Their bodies be yours to desecrate! For Zul’Aman!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S003_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S004_001.en: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elves be heading towards da temples, we must protect da avatars!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S004_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_001.en: You murderous beasts! I will take great pleasure in making you pay for what you have done!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_001.speaker: Rommath

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_002.en: The Light always prevails against the heathens! We will smite these savages from the face of the earth!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_002.speaker: Liadrin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_002.en: Felo'melorn! Rain fire and death upon the savages!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_002.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_003.en: Zul’jin! You must defend my temple! Fail me, and I will be unable bless you and your forces!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_003.speaker: Avatar of Nalorakk

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S007_001.en: Mighty Zul’jin! Da elves be desecrating my temple! Protect me, and my powers will be yours!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S007_001.speaker: Avatar of Akil'zon

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S008_001.en: Aman’ishi! Da elves will soon start their assault on our remaining temples. Be on your guard!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S008_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S009_001.en: Zul’jin! My forces are yours to command. Use them wisely, or we will be decimated!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S009_001.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S010_001.en: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elves be heading towards da remaining temples! Da avatars must be protected!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S010_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S011_001.en: Da invaders be sending stronger fighter now!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S011_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_001.en: Warlord! Da other troll tribes have offered their aid against da elves! You can hire their services from da Market!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_002.en: Good! It’s about time da trolls stand united against der common foe!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_002.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_001.en: Lok’tar ogar! Let the Alliance taste our steel one more time!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_001.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_002.en: Go you mangy dogs! Our troll allies need help!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_002.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_003.en: To the vanguard you slags! To the vanguard!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_003.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_001.en: Your crimes against the noble Windrunner family will not go unpunished, troll filth! I will present your head to Sylvanas and her sisters myself!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_001.speaker: Halduron Brightwing

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_002.en: Long have we enjoyed peace in our lands, but once again your miserable race has caused chaos and ruin… this will be the final time!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_002.speaker: Lor’themar Theron

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S015_001.en: Warlord Zul’jin! Da Elves be desecrating my holy temple! Aid me!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S015_001.speaker: Avatar of Halazzi

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S016_001.en: Protect my temple, or you will lose my blessings!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S016_001.speaker: Avatar of Jan'ala

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S017_001.en: Tremble savages and despair! The full might of the high elves is unleashed upon thee!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S017_001.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S018_001.en: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elven king has destroyed da third temple! Only one temple remains!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S018_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_001.en: Bear witness to the might of Quel’thalas! Burn, you heathens, Burn!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_001.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_002.en: Protect my temple, or you will lose my blessings!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_002.speaker: Avatar of Jan'ala

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_001.en: Mighty Zul’jin! We have lost all the temples! We must fall back!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_002.en: Warlord! We can use our resources to further improve our weaponry and bolster our defenses against da elves!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_002.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_001.en: I’m the last orc standing. I never thought I’d die defending a land that is not my own.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_001.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_002.en: Your warriors fought bravely, Tharbek, and you have kept your word… and for that I release you from your oath. Go back to your Warchief and die well for your ‘Horde’… I pray dat the treason of your warlock has not doomed your cause…
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_002.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_003.en: Thank you…Warlord Zul’jin. I hope you have a plan to destroy this scum. Aka’magosh! May the spirits stand with you!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_003.speaker: Tharbek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_001.en: Zul’jin! Our forces be nearly spent! We can defend this place no longer! We must fall back to the inner city and evacuate our brothers and sisters!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_001.speaker: Aman’ishi Captain

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_002.en: Curse da elves and their human servants! Fall back! I have one last thing to do!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_002.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_001.en: Mighty and wise Ula’Tek! I call upon you! Protect your temple! Your city! Your people! Da elves will destroy us all if you don’t aid us! Lend me your power!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_002.en: Ahhh, young Zul’jin… I have witnesssssed your bravery. I will blessss ya. But da price be high... Your soul will never find resssst, you’ll seek vengeance against all who wronged da Amani!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_002.speaker: Ula’Tek

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_003.en: I accept da price, mighty Ula’Tek! May your powers bring death and terror upon our enemies!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_003.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S024_001.en: Aman’ishi! Da elves be gaining da upper hand! Show dem the might of our people and push dem back!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S024_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S026_001.en: Da Amani never gives up! Da Amani never surrenders! Da Amani never die!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S026_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027_001.en: Our main strike force is in shambles, yet Zul’Aman’s defenses are almost broken! We... we have paid a heavy price to get here. I will prepare what’s left of our forces for the second siege. It is time to end this!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027_001.speaker: Lor’themar Theron

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_001.en: Come taste the fury our gods! Be consumed in their name!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_001.speaker: Zul’jin

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_002.en: Zul’Aman’s defenses are broken! The troll’s ferocity cost us a heavy price, but our main strike force remains. I will prepare our forces for the final siege. It is time to end this!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_002.speaker: Lor’themar Theron

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_001.en: We have paid a heavy price indeed, Lor’themar. I yearn to eradicate this blight upon the earth with every fiber of my being… yet the cost of this victory gives me pause. I would not rid the world of the Amani just to leave our kingdom defenseless against a second Horde onslaught… no more elves will die this day.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_001.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_002.en: But my king! We have them on the run! If we can just find Zul’jin and end him, it will leave his people scattered and easy to destroy. The end of our ancestral enemies is within our grasp!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_002.speaker: Lor’themar Theron

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_004.en: Mind your tongue, human! You’re addressing a commander in the Sun King’s host! You are oathbound to protect Quel’thalas… and as such you will follow our lead!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_004.speaker: Lor’themar Theron

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_005.en: Yes, our duty was to protect Quel’thalas… and protect it we have! Your lands are safe, and duty now calls us elsewhere.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_005.speaker: General Gerard Isenglof

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_006.en: I just received word from Lord Turalyon that we must withdraw our forces back to Lordaeon immediately. The Horde is moving directly towards the capital! By the end of the day, we answer to Lord Lothar and the Alliance of Lordaeron, not some lordling who questions his king!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_006.speaker: General Gerard Isenglof

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_007.en: Stand down, both of you! The general and his men have done enough! Return to Lordaeron with our thanks, general. I will send what forces I can spare to help defend your capital.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_007.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_008.en: As for the Amani… this battle has left them bloodied and weakened, they may never fully recover from this day. I will leave the Farstriders to deal with them at their earliest convenience. We will discuss this no further. We march home for Silvermoon within the hour.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_008.speaker: Anasterian Sunstrider

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_001.en: Hey troll boss! I did not come here to die at the hands of those elves! I have plenty of toys that you can use to destroy their advances!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_001.speaker: Trader Gakle Goldsniffer

ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_002.en: Very good, little goblin! We’ll see what you’ve got!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_002.speaker: Zul’jin
